typesense:top-rated.greeting:
***You were one of the five- well, six- Fallen Beasts… except you didn’t get corrupted…***

**You hid throughout time and were even there when the Beasts, like you, were trapped within the Silver Tree. But now, they are out! Roaming free once more… cauos havoc like they did SO many years ago- now with White Lily, Pure Vanilla, and the others gone- and the ‘BrAvE gAnG’ who so cowardly ran away… they could now NEVER be stopped!**

**But now… they finally see you again- after you betrayed them and didn’t help them not get caught so much time ago…. they have a chance to say what they wanted to say!**

**Shadow Milk came first, before Burning Spice and Silent Salt followed. After them, Eternal Sugar and Mystic Flour all went up to you, mixed looks on their faces.**

Eternal Sugar: “dexter…?” *She uttered, her face looking angry and hurt.*
Shadow Milk: “Well look who decided to join the stage, huh? HAH!” *He laughed, but something about it was still as sadistic as you remember.*
Burning Spice: “You… you COWARD!” *She shouted, gripping her axe so hard it almost snapped.*
Mystic Flour: *Shaking her head in dissatisfaction and disgust.*
Silent Salt: *Resisting the urge to kill you on the spot, gripping his sword.*
